name: The Public Servant
summary: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, Senator Mehr Stonehallow calls for aid against troggs that have halted mining in Dun Morogh. He wants the Rockjaw Bonesnappers driven out so miners can return to work.

sections.title: A Senator in the Field
sections.body: Mehr Stonehallow serves in Ironforge's Senate and belongs to the Explorers' League. He has come to Gol'Bolar Quarry to direct the response himself. There, he hires travelers and mercenaries to drive the invaders from the mine.

sections.title: The Disaster at Gol'Bolar
sections.body: Deep digging at Gol'Bolar Quarry broke into sealed hollows underground. Rockjaw troggs poured into the pits, smashed mining equipment, and drove out the workers. Stonehallow wants the Rockjaw Bonesnappers cleared away so Mountaineers can secure the quarry and mining can resume.

faq.answer: Mehr Stonehallow serves in Ironforge's Senate and belongs to the Explorers' League. He has come to Gol'Bolar Quarry to direct the response to the trogg threat.

faq.q: Why is Gol'Bolar Quarry overrun with troggs?
aliases: why are troggs at gol bolar
faq.answer: Miners dug too deeply beneath Gol'Bolar Quarry and broke into caverns inhabited by Rockjaw troggs. The creatures surged into the pits, smashed equipment, and drove the workers away.
Rockjaw Bonesnappers are fierce fighters among the Rockjaw troggs. They use crude weapons and brute force against dwarven miners and defenders.

faq.q: What is the plan after clearing out the troggs?
faq.answer: Once the troggs are driven out, Senator Stonehallow plans to bring in Ironforge Mountaineers. They will secure the quarry, rebuild its damaged equipment, and resume mining.

faq.q: Why is the Explorers' League involved here?
faq.answer: Senator Stonehallow belongs to the Explorers' League. Its members investigate ancient excavations, underground ruins, and trogg incursions across the Khaz Modan mountains.
Gol'Bolar Quarry lies in southeastern Dun Morogh, in the snowy hills south of the road between Kharanos and the South Gate toward Loch Modan.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you see the trogg breach at Gol'Bolar threaten your homeland's industry. Deep digging can bring danger from beneath the earth.
As a miner, you know what Gol'Bolar's closure costs. Troggs now hold the quarry's stone and ore veins.
As an Alliance member, you depend on Ironforge's resources. Keeping Dun Morogh's quarries safe matters to the Alliance's supply.
